blocks.text: Magnum Photos presents the 28th Square Print Sale, Fact/Fiction , which starts today and runs until Sunday, November 1, 2026.

Where is the line between documentation and storytelling? Fact/Fiction , the October Square Print Sale , offers over 70 images selected by Magnum photographers and estates, exploring the space between the truth and the imagination. Available as limited-edition, signed or estate-stamped 6×6 or 9×9 prints, these photographs have the power to make documentation feel dreamlike and unlikely moments seem believable. From surprising narratives to mysterious illusions and reflections, the selection blurs the boundaries between how things appear and how they really are.

Offering work by Martin Parr, Harry Gruyaert, Steve McCurry, Susan Meiselas, Eve Arnold, and many more, Fact/Fiction spans decades of photography, a medium that constantly asks us to question how we see the world and how we are seen.
